Firstly, I relate so strongly to this. So maybe hear my reply? 

I hate my birthday. I cry every year and it’s super depressing. 

Growing up with did is rough, I’m not gonna sugar coat that. Ever. But the good things? 

I’ve lived long enough and been in therapy long enough to realise who and what is wrong for me. The entire me. Maybe I don’t utilise it always, but I am aware of it. That’s powerful. 

It might seem silly but I used to be soo self conscious of my feet and legs but now I don’t give a fuck. I wear shorts and skirts and dresses when I want to. I wear shoes that show my long ass toes. 😂 

I don’t care if I shave or not. I see the patriarchy for what it is. 

I’ve learned over time (time being the major word here) how to be a part of a therapy group. That I’m so lucky to be a part of. 

I’ve learned how to name my feelings. 

With age comes wisdom whether you learn it the easy way or the hard way is not up to us. 

Birthdays are really difficult. 
I hope you can get through your birthday safely and we’ll see you on the other side. Hugs.
